objective: 将Phase34冻结的六模型PP H0+DNN residual 12-bin直方图与Hfull target确定性代入Phase37已验收的单机物理P2P连续曲线，重算通信cost误差；不重放checkpoint、不训练
execution_scope: CPU-only deterministic post-processing after the Phase37 result commit has been accepted and ff-only integrated

required_phase37_curve_contract.backend: torch.distributed.isend/irecv over NCCL device process group, matching SGLang async send_tensor_dict tensor primitive
required_phase37_curve_contract.direction_policy: 每个GPU对双向分别测量；拓扑类别正式曲线在每次repeat取双向中位数的较大值，再跨repeat取中位数，禁止挑选较快方向
required_phase37_curve_contract.interpolation: piecewise linear over log2(payload_bytes), using unsmoothed median across repeat medians

cost_semantics.curve_lookup: piecewise linear in log2(payload_bytes), clamped to the first or last physical knot outside the measured range
cost_semantics.sender_counting: sender-only logical messages, identical to the Phase34 histogram and Phase37 measurement contract

result_status: PASS means deterministic integrity and contract checks passed; it does not mean every physical cost WAPE is below 5%
claim_boundary: Phase38 does not create new predictions and therefore calls/bytes/TV/EMD must remain the Phase34 frozen values
Phase34D target was already opened, so physical-cost metrics are repeated engineering evidence rather than a new blind test
Only topology categories physically measured and accepted in Phase37 may be labeled physical
No end-to-end metadata, allocation, scheduler, overlap, multi-node, L2, or L3 cost is measured here
Any retraining proposal must use a new development and confirmation protocol; Phase34D targets cannot be reused to claim a new blind result
stop_and_block_if: Phase37 result commit has not been accepted and ff-only integrated before W38
Phase37 summary status is not accepted or its result manifest fails
Phase37 curve evidence, backend scope, interpolation, payload grid, or topology scope differs from the frozen contract
Phase34 or Phase35 pinned input SHA/manifest differs
running requires a GPU, checkpoint, model weights, raw trace, or training
the formal result directory already exists
fail_if: prediction and target example_id sets are not exactly equal after the frozen filters
Phase34 histogram metrics cannot be reproduced within absolute tolerance 1e-12
cost rows, metric rows, curve evidence, or finite-value checks violate the deterministic result contract
